user.description: Set up 3ERL zero-injection curtailment. The integration polls the 3ERL API and controls a relay to limit PV export when requested. Choose 'aci' for individual self-consumption or 'acc' for collective self-consumption. The PRD3 day offset is used to estimate the daily ACI price when Enedis has not yet published today's profile.
user.title: 3ERL Zero-Injection

data_description.pv_power_entity: Sensor(s) reporting current PV production in watts. With several production sources, select all of them: values are summed.
data_description.consumption_power_entity: Sensor reporting current home consumption in watts. When set, the curtailed-power estimate uses production minus consumption instead of production alone.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the 3ERL API. Check the URL and network.

data_description.consumption_power_entity: Sensor reporting current home consumption in watts. When set, the curtailed-power estimate uses production minus consumption instead of production alone.

state.latest_prep: Latest positive imbalance settlement price (PRE+) published by 3ERL, refreshed every quarter-hour.

state.prd4: Daily weighted average PRE+ published by 3ERL for the current day.

state.prep_profile_num: Daily PRE+ weighted by the PRD3 profile, as computed by 3ERL.

state.current_prep: Latest quarter-hour PRE+ published by RTE. Used for the gain estimate under ACC contracts.

state.estimated_daily_prep: Estimated daily PRE+ for ACI, weighted by the Enedis PRD3 profile of the target day.

state.daily_trend: Price trend published by 3ERL for the day.

state.last_update: Timestamp of the latest 3ERL API data refresh. The next poll runs about 18 minutes after this time.

state.long_term_curtailment: Time until which a long-term curtailment applies, when announced by 3ERL.

state.rte_unavailable_since: Timestamp since which RTE price data is unavailable, as reported by 3ERL.

state.curtailable_power: Estimated surplus power curtailed while zero-injection is active: production minus consumption when a consumption sensor is configured, production otherwise.

state.gain_rate: Estimated remuneration rate of the curtailed surplus at 70% of PRE+.

state.cumulative_gain: Total estimated gain accumulated while curtailment is active. Persisted across restarts; resettable with the reset_counters action.

state.curtailment_requested: On when the 3ERL ACI curtailment signal (Bridage) is active.

state.cdc_curtailment_requested: On when the 3ERL collective curtailment signal (Bridage_CDC) is active.

state.zero_inject_active: On while zero-injection is applied to the relay(s). See the mode and reason attributes for details.

state.mode_on: Relay forced ON - zero-injection always active.

reset_counters.name: Reset counters
reset_counters.description: Reset the cumulative curtailed energy and estimated gain counters for all 3ERL config entries.
